relationship: genuine incomplete fix — the first official patch bash43-025 (for CVE-2014-6271) was insufficient; CVE-2014-7169 demonstrates bash still mis-parses crafted env-var function definitions on the 025-patched parser. Closed by bash43-026 (+027).
incomplete_fix_quote: GNU Bash through 4.3 bash43-025 processes trailing strings after certain malformed function definitions in the values of environment variables, which allows remote attackers to write to files or possibly have unknown other impact via a crafted environment, as demonstrated by vectors involving the ForceCommand feature in OpenSSH sshd, the mod_cgi and mod_cgid modules in the Apache HTTP Server, ... NOTE: this vulnerability exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2014-6271.
residual_vector: () { (a)=>\  — Tavis Ormandy's vector: a dangling redirection in a malformed function-definition value leaks into the parse of the next command word on the 025-patched parser, still yielding command execution / arbitrary file write.
